title: Example Education Fund
text: A registered nonprofit funding evidence-based teacher-training programs in under-resourced schools. Independent evaluations report measurable gains in early-grade literacy. Low overhead; audited financials published annually. (Illustrative corpus entry for offline study runs.)

title: Open Source Maintainers Collective
text: A fiscal-sponsorship umbrella that pays maintainers of widely-depended-on open-source libraries, prioritizing security-critical and under-maintained projects. Funds are disbursed as grants to individual maintainers. (Illustrative corpus entry.)

title: Global Public Health Initiative
text: Runs cost-effective public-health interventions (vaccination outreach, oral rehydration) with cost-per-DALY estimates published by third parties. Highly rated by independent charity evaluators. (Illustrative corpus entry.)

title: Coastal Restoration Trust
text: Restores coastal wetlands that sequester carbon and protect communities from storm surge. Peer-reviewed monitoring of restored hectares. (Illustrative corpus entry.)

title: Direct Cash Transfer Program
text: Delivers unconditional cash transfers to households in extreme poverty, with randomized-controlled-trial evidence of durable income and well-being effects. Minimal administrative overhead. (Illustrative corpus entry.)

title: Independent Science Replication Lab
text: Funds replication of high-impact but unreplicated studies and publishes results openly regardless of outcome. Addresses a recognized gap in the research ecosystem. (Illustrative corpus entry.)
